item.tib: phyi nang gsang gsum gyi dkyil 'khor 'bri thabs rab 'byams rig pa'i sgo 'byed
item.coloph: ces pa rang re bon phyogs kyi bstan bcos gang rgyas phab dgos zhes mkhas grub zung ldan smon rgyal nam mkha' grags pa'i bkas bskul spyi phab gzhir bcang / nye char dge g.yung tshul/ bstan tshul/ sngags rgyal mtshan sogs nye gnas du mas rang re'i rnam thar dang rig gnas sogs snyigs 'gror sman pa'i bka' 'bum gang rgyas mdzad dgos zhes yang yang bskal phyir/ bon phyogs kyi phyi nang gsang yang dkyil 'khor gyi thig rtsa rab 'byams rig pa'i sgo 'byed ces bya ba 'di nyid gshen gyi drang srong 'jig med nam mkha' 'am/ ga btsun g.yung drung rgyal mtshan dpal bzang por 'bod pas zhang zhung khyung chen spungs rir g.yung drung rin 'bar ke'u tshang du/ 'byung ldan sum brgya'i nang tshan chu sbrul lor hor zla dgu pa'i tshes bcu'i nyin mjug yongs su grub par bgyis pas/ dge des gyer bstan rgud gso'i dpal du gyur te mtha' yas ma rnams srid pa'i 'ching ba las grol te lhun grub sgo brgyad bum sku'i gzhi ru ye sangs rgyas pa'i rgyu ru gyur cig dge'o//
